parameters.query:
UPDATE companies
SET
    extraction_status = 'failed',
    extraction_error = $1
WHERE extraction_status = 'processing'
RETURNING
    company_id,
    company_name,
    extraction_status,
    extraction_error;

parameters.text:
={{ "🚨 *Workflow Error:* " + ($('Format Error Details').first().json.workflow_name || "Unknown Workflow") + "

*Failed Node:* `" + $('Format Error Details').first().json.failed_node + "`
